fact: Jigitugu, an education MIS collecting real-time learner enrolment, attendance and performance data, was piloted in PASCOFI schools (cash programme in 200 schools in 2024/25) and formally handed over to the Ministry of Education in October 2025.
title: Le Projet d'appui à la scolarisation des filles affectées par le conflit au Mali (PASCOFI)
